ing is accomplished between the xenon flashlamp metal connecting arms and the il-

                    Section Il. GENERAL SUPPORT TROUBLESHOOTING

                                                        WARNING
Dangerous voltages exist in the pod assembly (Unit 10) high voltage circuits after
power has been removed. Use a ground rod with a series 5-kilohm, 10-watt resist-
or, and discharge all high voltage circuits before touching any of the components.
The grounding is accomplished between the Xenon flashlamp metal connecting
arms and the illuminator module chassis.

                                                       WARNING
Be careful when working on the 115-volt ac, 400-Hz, line connections and the 28-
volt de connections. Serious injury or death may result from contact with these ter-
minals. Use insulated test probes when making the required voltage measurements.
Insure that major component is disconnected from power source when touching in-
ternal parts.
